{{Quote|We'll hide the ''Nebulon Ranger'' in the shadow of the Tetan moon.|Cay Qel-Droma|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi &ndash; Dark Lords of the Sith 5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Atale''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]]. It was used as a production site of the [[Andris/Legends|andris]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. During their [[Mission to Empress Teta|mission]] to Empress Teta in [[3997 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Cay Qel-Droma]] and [[Tott Doneeta]] hid their [[Coruscant-class Heavy Courier|starship]], the ''[[Nebulon Ranger]]'', in the shadow of the moon. Later, Qel-Droma and Doneeta [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ''Nebulon Ranger'' away from the moon and down to Empress Teta's surface.

==Description==
A red-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="TotJ" /> Atale<ref name="NoP" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]],<ref name="TotJ" /> in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]] of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core's]]<ref name="WotC" /> [[Koros sector/Legends|Koros sector]].<ref name="NoP" /> Like the rest of the [[Star system/Legends|system]], Atale was connected to the [[Keeara Major system/Legends|Keeara Major system]] by the [[Byss Run/Legends|Byss Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]<ref name="TEA-Empress Teta" /> and to the [[Jerrilek system/Legends|Jerrilek system]]<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]]</ref> by the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]].<ref name="TEA-Empress Teta" />

In addition, in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the hyperspace [[Cartographer/Legends|mappers]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]] discovered a direct route, later named the [[Daragon Trail]], linking the Empress Teta system<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> to the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The section of the Daragon Trail beginning at Empress Teta and running through the Deep Core eventually became part of the [[Carbonite Run/Legends|Carbonite Run]] hyperlane.<ref name="WotC" />

==History==
Atale was used by the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]] as the main production site of the [[Andris/Legends|andris]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="NoP" /> In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Nomi Sunrider]], [[Cay Qel-Droma]], and [[Tott Doneeta]] undertook a [[Mission to Empress Teta|mission]] to extract Cay's brother, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], from deep cover within the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] cult on Empress Teta. After Sunrider left the Knights' [[Coruscant-class Heavy Courier|starship]], the ''[[Nebulon Ranger]]'', for Empress Teta's surface in an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]], Cay and Doneeta hid the [[Courier/Legends|ship]] in the shadow of Atale. Later, the pair [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ''Nebulon Ranger'' out of its hiding place and down to the planet's surface in order to pick up Sunrider and Ulic.<ref name="TotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Atale was introduced in the [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 5|fifth issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith|''Dark Lords of the Sith'']] story arc in [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series.<ref name="TotJ" /> The issue was published on [[February 14]], [[1995]],<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54575/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_dark_lords_of_the_sith_1994_5|text=Star Wars: Tales Of The Jedi - Dark Lords Of The Sith (1994) #5}}</ref> written by [[Tom Veitch]] and [[Kevin J. Anderson]], and penciled by [[Chris Gossett]].<ref name="TotJ" />

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Empress Teta system, and therefore Atale, in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA-Empress Teta" /> Atale received its name in the [[2016]] [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' sourcebook ''[[Nexus of Power]]''.<ref name="NoP" />
